/*
 * This file is part of the Meteor Client distribution (https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client).
 * Copyright (c) Meteor Development.
 */

package meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui;

import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.MeteorClient;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.renderer.GuiDebugRenderer;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.renderer.GuiRenderer;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.tabs.TabScreen;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.utils.Cell;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.widgets.WRoot;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.widgets.WWidget;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.widgets.containers.WContainer;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.widgets.input.WTextBox;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.utils.Utils;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.utils.misc.CursorStyle;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.utils.misc.input.Input;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.Screen;
import net.minecraft.client.util.math.MatrixStack;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

import static meteordevelopment.meteorclient.MeteorClient.mc;
import static meteordevelopment.meteorclient.utils.Utils.getWindowHeight;
import static meteordevelopment.meteorclient.utils.Utils.getWindowWidth;
import static org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.*;

public abstract class WidgetScreen extends Screen {
    private static final GuiRenderer RENDERER = new GuiRenderer();
    private static final GuiDebugRenderer DEBUG_RENDERER = new GuiDebugRenderer();

    public Runnable taskAfterRender;
    protected Runnable enterAction;

    public Screen parent;
    private final WContainer root;

    protected final GuiTheme theme;

    public boolean locked, lockedAllowClose;
    private boolean closed;
    private boolean onClose;
    private boolean debug;

    private double lastMouseX, lastMouseY;

    public double animProgress;

    private List<Runnable> onClosed;

    protected boolean firstInit = true;

    public WidgetScreen(GuiTheme theme, String title) {
        super(Text.literal(title));

        this.parent = mc.currentScreen;
        this.root = new WFullScreenRoot();
        this.theme = theme;

        root.theme = theme;

        if (parent != null) {
            animProgress = 1;

            if (this instanceof TabScreen && parent instanceof TabScreen) {
                parent = ((TabScreen) parent).parent;
            }
        }
    }

    public <W extends WWidget> Cell<W> add(W widget) {
        return root.add(widget);
    }

    public void clear() {
        root.clear();
    }

    public void invalidate() {
        root.invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        MeteorClient.EVENT_BUS.subscribe(this);

        closed = false;

        if (firstInit) {
            firstInit = false;
            initWidgets();
        }
    }

    public abstract void initWidgets();

    public void reload() {
        clear();
        initWidgets();
    }

    public void onClosed(Runnable action) {
        if (onClosed == null) onClosed = new ArrayList<>(2);
        onClosed.add(action);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (locked) return false;

        double s = mc.getWindow().getScaleFactor();
        mouseX *= s;
        mouseY *= s;

        return root.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button, false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (locked) return false;

        double s = mc.getWindow().getScaleFactor();
        mouseX *= s;
        mouseY *= s;

        return root.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public void mouseMoved(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        if (locked) return;

        double s = mc.getWindow().getScaleFactor();
        mouseX *= s;
        mouseY *= s;

        root.mouseMoved(mouseX, mouseY, lastMouseX, lastMouseY);

        lastMouseX = mouseX;
        lastMouseY = mouseY;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (locked) return false;

        root.mouseScrolled(verticalAmount);

        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyReleased(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (locked) return false;

        if ((modifiers == GLFW_MOD_CONTROL || modifiers == GLFW_MOD_SUPER) && keyCode == GLFW_KEY_9) {
            debug = !debug;
            return true;
        }

        if ((keyCode == GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER) && enterAction != null) {
            enterAction.run();
            return true;
        }

        return super.keyReleased(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (locked) return false;

        boolean shouldReturn = root.keyPressed(keyCode, modifiers) || super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
        if (shouldReturn) return true;

        // Select next text box if TAB was pressed
        if (keyCode == GLFW_KEY_TAB) {
            AtomicReference<WTextBox> firstTextBox = new AtomicReference<>(null);
            AtomicBoolean done = new AtomicBoolean(false);
            AtomicBoolean foundFocused = new AtomicBoolean(false);

            loopWidgets(root, wWidget -> {
                if (done.get() || !(wWidget instanceof WTextBox textBox)) return;

                if (foundFocused.get()) {
                    textBox.setFocused(true);
                    textBox.setCursorMax();

                    done.set(true);
                } else {
                    if (textBox.isFocused()) {
                        textBox.setFocused(false);
                        foundFocused.set(true);
                    }
                }

                if (firstTextBox.get() == null) firstTextBox.set(textBox);
            });

            if (!done.get() && firstTextBox.get() != null) {
                firstTextBox.get().setFocused(true);
                firstTextBox.get().setCursorMax();
            }

            return true;
        }

        boolean control = MinecraftClient.IS_SYSTEM_MAC ? modifiers == GLFW_MOD_SUPER : modifiers == GLFW_MOD_CONTROL;

        if (control && keyCode == GLFW_KEY_C && toClipboard()) {
            return true;
        } else if (control && keyCode == GLFW_KEY_V && fromClipboard()) {
            reload();
            if (parent instanceof WidgetScreen wScreen) {
                wScreen.reload();
            }
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public void keyRepeated(int key, int modifiers) {
        if (locked) return;

        root.keyRepeated(key, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int keyCode) {
        if (locked) return false;

        return root.charTyped(chr);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        if (!Utils.canUpdate()) renderBackground(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);

        double s = mc.getWindow().getScaleFactor();
        mouseX *= s;
        mouseY *= s;

        animProgress += delta / 20 * 14;
        animProgress = MathHelper.clamp(animProgress, 0, 1);

        GuiKeyEvents.canUseKeys = true;

        // Apply projection without scaling
        context.draw();
        Utils.unscaledProjection();

        onRenderBefore(context, delta);

        RENDERER.theme = theme;
        theme.beforeRender();

        RENDERER.begin(context);
        RENDERER.setAlpha(animProgress);
        root.render(RENDERER, mouseX, mouseY, delta / 20);
        RENDERER.setAlpha(1);
        RENDERER.end();

        boolean tooltip = RENDERER.renderTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta / 20);

        if (debug) {
            MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();

            DEBUG_RENDERER.render(root, matrices);
            if (tooltip) DEBUG_RENDERER.render(RENDERER.tooltipWidget, matrices);
        }

        context.draw();
        Utils.scaledProjection();

        runAfterRenderTasks();
    }

    protected void runAfterRenderTasks() {
        if (taskAfterRender != null) {
            taskAfterRender.run();
            taskAfterRender = null;
        }
    }

    protected void onRenderBefore(DrawContext drawContext, float delta) {}

    @Override
    public void resize(MinecraftClient client, int width, int height) {
        super.resize(client, width, height);
        root.invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        if (!locked || lockedAllowClose) {
            boolean preOnClose = onClose;
            onClose = true;

            removed();

            onClose = preOnClose;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void removed() {
        if (!closed || lockedAllowClose) {
            closed = true;
            onClosed();

            Input.setCursorStyle(CursorStyle.Default);

            loopWidgets(root, widget -> {
                if (widget instanceof WTextBox textBox && textBox.isFocused()) textBox.setFocused(false);
            });

            MeteorClient.EVENT_BUS.unsubscribe(this);
            GuiKeyEvents.canUseKeys = true;

            if (onClosed != null) {
                for (Runnable action : onClosed) action.run();
            }

            if (onClose) {
                taskAfterRender = () -> {
                    locked = true;
                    mc.setScreen(parent);
                };
            }
        }
    }

    private void loopWidgets(WWidget widget, Consumer<WWidget> action) {
        action.accept(widget);

        if (widget instanceof WContainer) {
            for (Cell<?> cell : ((WContainer) widget).cells) loopWidgets(cell.widget(), action);
        }
    }

    protected void onClosed() {}

    public boolean toClipboard() {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean fromClipboard() {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldCloseOnEsc() {
        return !locked || lockedAllowClose;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldPause() {
        return false;
    }

    private static class WFullScreenRoot extends WContainer implements WRoot {
        private boolean valid;

        @Override
        public void invalidate() {
            valid = false;
        }

        @Override
        protected void onCalculateSize() {
            width = getWindowWidth();
            height = getWindowHeight();
        }

        @Override
        protected void onCalculateWidgetPositions() {
            for (Cell<?> cell : cells) {
                cell.x = 0;
                cell.y = 0;

                cell.width = width;
                cell.height = height;

                cell.alignWidget();
            }
        }

        @Override
        public boolean render(GuiRenderer renderer, double mouseX, double mouseY, double delta) {
            if (!valid) {
                calculateSize();
                calculateWidgetPositions();

                valid = true;
                mouseMoved(mc.mouse.getX(), mc.mouse.getY(), mc.mouse.getX(), mc.mouse.getY());
            }

            return super.render(renderer, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        }
    }
}

===== meteor-fork\src\main\java\meteordevelopment\meteorclient\gui\morzh\MorzhAnimUtil.java =====
/*
 * Morzh Client
 *
 * Animation behavior independently implemented after studying:
 * - Meteor Client (GPLv3)
 * - ThunderHack Recode (GPLv3)
 * - Rasty Client metadata declares MIT
 * - Rockstar Client visual behavior
 */

package meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.morzh;

public final class MorzhAnimUtil {
    private static final float DEFAULT_DELTA = 1.0f / 60.0f;
    private static final float MAX_DELTA = 0.05f;

    private static long lastFrameNanos;
    private static float frameDelta = DEFAULT_DELTA;

    private MorzhAnimUtil() {
    }

    public static float beginFrame() {
        long now = System.nanoTime();

        if (lastFrameNanos == 0L) {
            lastFrameNanos = now;
            frameDelta = DEFAULT_DELTA;
            return frameDelta;
        }

        frameDelta = (now - lastFrameNanos) / 1_000_000_000.0f;
        lastFrameNanos = now;

        if (!Float.isFinite(frameDelta) || frameDelta <= 0.0f) {
            frameDelta = DEFAULT_DELTA;
        }

        frameDelta = Math.min(frameDelta, MAX_DELTA);
        return frameDelta;
    }

    public static float frameDelta() {
        return frameDelta;
    }

    public static float approach(
        float current,
        float target,
        float responsiveness,
        float deltaSeconds
    ) {
        if (!Float.isFinite(current)) return target;
        if (!Float.isFinite(target)) return current;

        float difference = target - current;

        if (Math.abs(difference) <= 0.0005f) {
            return target;
        }

        float safeResponsiveness = Math.max(0.0f, responsiveness);
        float safeDelta = Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(deltaSeconds, MAX_DELTA));

        float factor = 1.0f - (float) Math.exp(
            -safeResponsiveness * safeDelta
        );

        return current + difference * clamp01(factor);
    }

    public static double approach(
        double current,
        double target,
        double responsiveness,
        double deltaSeconds
    ) {
        if (!Double.isFinite(current)) return target;
        if (!Double.isFinite(target)) return current;

        double difference = target - current;

        if (Math.abs(difference) <= 0.0005) {
            return target;
        }

        double safeResponsiveness = Math.max(0.0, responsiveness);
        double safeDelta = Math.max(0.0, Math.min(deltaSeconds, MAX_DELTA));

        double factor = 1.0 - Math.exp(
            -safeResponsiveness * safeDelta
        );

        return current + difference * clamp01(factor);
    }

    /*
     * Compatibility method for existing Morzh code.
     * Smaller divisor remains faster, matching the previous API.
     */
    public static float fast(
        float current,
        float target,
        float speed
    ) {
        float divisor = Math.max(1.0f, speed);
        float responsiveness = 60.0f / divisor;

        return approach(
            current,
            target,
            responsiveness,
            frameDelta
        );
    }

    public static double fast(
        double current,
        double target,
        double speed
    ) {
        double divisor = Math.max(1.0, speed);
        double responsiveness = 60.0 / divisor;

        return approach(
            current,
            target,
            responsiveness,
            frameDelta
        );
    }

    public static float lerp(float from, float to, float progress) {
        return from + (to - from) * clamp01(progress);
    }

    public static double lerp(
        double from,
        double to,
        double progress
    ) {
        return from + (to - from) * clamp01(progress);
    }

    public static float easeOutQuad(float value) {
        float t = clamp01(value);
        return 1.0f - (1.0f - t) * (1.0f - t);
    }

    public static float easeOutCubic(float value) {
        float t = clamp01(value);
        float inverse = 1.0f - t;

        return 1.0f - inverse * inverse * inverse;
    }

    public static float easeInOutCubic(float value) {
        float t = clamp01(value);

        if (t < 0.5f) {
            return 4.0f * t * t * t;
        }

        float inverse = -2.0f * t + 2.0f;
        return 1.0f - inverse * inverse * inverse / 2.0f;
    }

    public static float easeOutQuart(float value) {
        float t = clamp01(value);
        float inverse = 1.0f - t;

        return 1.0f - inverse * inverse * inverse * inverse;
    }

    public static float easeOutBack(float value) {
        float t = clamp01(value);
        float c1 = 1.70158f;
        float c3 = c1 + 1.0f;
        float shifted = t - 1.0f;

        return 1.0f
            + c3 * shifted * shifted * shifted
            + c1 * shifted * shifted;
    }

    public static float clamp01(float value) {
        return Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, value));
    }

    public static double clamp01(double value) {
        return Math.max(0.0, Math.min(1.0, value));
    }
}


===== meteor-fork\src\main\java\meteordevelopment\meteorclient\gui\morzh\MorzhFontRenderer.java =====
package meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.morzh;

import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.renderer.Fonts;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.renderer.text.TextRenderer;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.utils.render.color.Color;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;

public final class MorzhFontRenderer {
    private MorzhFontRenderer() {}
    public static void draw(DrawContext context, String text, double x, double y, int packedColor, boolean shadow) {
        if (text == null || text.isEmpty() || Fonts.RENDERER == null) return;
        TextRenderer renderer = Fonts.RENDERER;
        Color color = new Color(packedColor >> 16 & 255, packedColor >> 8 & 255, packedColor & 255, packedColor >>> 24);
        renderer.begin(0.5);
        renderer.render(text, x, y, color, shadow);
        renderer.end(context.getMatrices());
    }
    public static double width(String text) {
        if (text == null || text.isEmpty() || Fonts.RENDERER == null) return 0;
        TextRenderer renderer = Fonts.RENDERER;
        renderer.begin(0.5);
        double width = renderer.getWidth(text);
        renderer.end();
        return width;
    }
}

===== meteor-fork\src\main\java\meteordevelopment\meteorclient\gui\morzh\MorzhGui.java =====
/*
 * Morzh Client
 * Central GUI style selection and screen opening.
 */

package meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.morzh;

import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.GuiThemes;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.morzh.classic.MorzhClassicScreen;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.morzh.dashboard.MorzhDashboardScreen;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.tabs.Tabs;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.systems.config.Config;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.utils.Utils;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.Screen;

import static meteordevelopment.meteorclient.MeteorClient.mc;

public final class MorzhGui {
    private MorzhGui() {}

    public enum Style {
        Meteor("Meteor"),
        MorzhClassic("Morzh Classic"),
        MorzhDashboard("Morzh Dashboard");

        private final String label;

        Style(String label) {
            this.label = label;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return label;
        }
    }

    public static Style getStyle() {
        return Config.get().guiStyle.get();
    }

    public static boolean isMorzhScreen(Screen screen) {
        return screen instanceof MorzhClassicScreen || screen instanceof MorzhDashboardScreen;
    }

    public static boolean canCloseMorzhGui(Screen screen) {
        return isMorzhScreen(screen);
    }

    public static void open() {
        switch (getStyle()) {
            case MorzhClassic -> mc.setScreen(new MorzhClassicScreen());
            case MorzhDashboard -> mc.setScreen(new MorzhDashboardScreen());
            default -> Tabs.get().getFirst().openScreen(GuiThemes.get());
        }
    }

    public static void toggle() {
        if (mc.currentScreen != null && (Utils.canCloseGui() || canCloseMorzhGui(mc.currentScreen))) {
            mc.currentScreen.close();
        } else if (Utils.canOpenGui()) {
            open();
        }
    }
}


===== meteor-fork\src\main\java\meteordevelopment\meteorclient\gui\morzh\MorzhModuleSearch.java =====
package meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.screens.morzh;

import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.systems.modules.Module;
import org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW;

import java.util.Locale;

public final class MorzhModuleSearch {
    private static final int MAX_LENGTH = 40;

    private String query = "";
    private boolean focused;

    public String getQuery() {
        return query;
    }

    public String getNormalizedQuery() {
        return query.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    public boolean isEmpty() {
        return query.isBlank();
    }

    public boolean isFocused() {
        return focused;
    }

    public void setFocused(boolean focused) {
        this.focused = focused;
    }

    public void clear() {
        query = "";
    }

    public boolean matches(Module module) {
        String search = getNormalizedQuery();

        if (search.isEmpty()) {
            return true;
        }

        if (contains(module.name, search)) {
            return true;
        }

        if (contains(module.title, search)) {
            return true;
        }

        if (contains(module.description, search)) {
            return true;
        }

        for (String alias : module.aliases) {
            if (contains(alias, search)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode) {
        if (!focused) {
            return false;
        }

        if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE
            || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER
            || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER) {
            focused = false;
            return true;
        }

        if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE) {
            if (!query.isEmpty()) {
                query = query.substring(0, query.length() - 1);
            }

            return true;
        }

        if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_DELETE) {
            clear();
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    public boolean charTyped(char character) {
        if (!focused
            || Character.isISOControl(character)
            || query.length() >= MAX_LENGTH) {
            return false;
        }

        query += character;
        return true;
    }

    public String getRenderedText() {
        if (query.isEmpty()) {
            return focused ? "Type to search..." : "Search modules";
        }

        if (focused
            && (System.currentTimeMillis() / 450L) % 2L == 0L) {
            return query + "_";
        }

        return query;
    }

    private boolean contains(String value, String search) {
        return value != null
            && value.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(search);
    }
}


===== meteor-fork\src\main\java\meteordevelopment\meteorclient\gui\morzh\MorzhRenderUtil.java =====
/*
 * Morzh Client
 * Shared 2D drawing helpers for Morzh GUI screens.
 * Visual approach inspired by ThunderHack Recode (GPLv3).
 */

package meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.morzh;

import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.themes.morzh.MorzhGuiColors;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.utils.render.color.Color;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;
import net.minecraft.client.util.math.MatrixStack;

public final class MorzhRenderUtil {
    private MorzhRenderUtil() {}

    public static boolean hovered(double mouseX, double mouseY, double x, double y, double w, double h) {
        return mouseX >= x && mouseX <= x + w && mouseY >= y && mouseY <= y + h;
    }

    public static void fill(DrawContext context, double x, double y, double w, double h, Color color) {
        context.fill((int) x, (int) y, (int) (x + w), (int) (y + h), color.getPacked());
    }

    public static void panel(DrawContext context, double x, double y, double w, double h) {
        fill(context, x, y, w, h, MorzhGuiColors.PANEL);
        border(context, x, y, w, h, MorzhGuiColors.OUTLINE);
    }

    public static void border(DrawContext context, double x, double y, double w, double h, Color color) {
        fill(context, x, y, w, 1, color);
        fill(context, x, y + h - 1, w, 1, color);
        fill(context, x, y, 1, h, color);
        fill(context, x + w - 1, y, 1, h, color);
    }

    public static void gradientBar(DrawContext context, double x, double y, double w, double h, float progress) {
        double fillW = w * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));
        fill(context, x, y, w, h, MorzhGuiColors.SLIDER_TRACK);
        if (fillW > 0) fill(context, x, y, fillW, h, MorzhGuiColors.SLIDER_FILL);
        border(context, x, y, w, h, MorzhGuiColors.OUTLINE);
    }

    public static void text(DrawContext context, String text, double x, double y, Color color, boolean shadow) {
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();
        if (shadow) {
            context.drawTextWithShadow(net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient.getInstance().textRenderer, text, (int) x, (int) y, color.getPacked());
        } else {
            context.drawText(net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient.getInstance().textRenderer, text, (int) x, (int) y, color.getPacked(), false);
        }
    }

    public static void centeredText(DrawContext context, String text, double x, double y, double w, Color color) {
        var tr = net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient.getInstance().textRenderer;
        int tw = tr.getWidth(text);
        context.drawTextWithShadow(tr, text, (int) (x + (w - tw) / 2), (int) y, color.getPacked());
    }

    public static int textWidth(String text) {
        return net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient.getInstance().textRenderer.getWidth(text);
    }
}


===== meteor-fork\src\main\java\meteordevelopment\meteorclient\gui\morzh\MorzhSmoothRenderer.java =====
package meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.morzh;

import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.renderer.Mesh;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.renderer.Renderer2D;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.utils.render.color.Color;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;

/**
 * Shared "smooth" drawing helpers for the whole client HUD.
 *
 * Everything here goes through the vector Renderer2D pipeline instead of
 * DrawContext#fill, and every corner is a real curve with a soft
 * anti-aliased edge instead of a hard right angle. That's what actually
 * caused the "Minecraft pixelated" look before: this class used to just
 * call context.fill() (a flat, square, unantialiased rectangle) despite
 * its name.
 *
 * Any HUD module can now call MorzhSmoothRenderer.roundedRect(...) /
 * .circle(...) / .text(...) to get the same smooth look as the Target HUD,
 * instead of every module inventing its own rounding code.
 */
public final class MorzhSmoothRenderer {
    // Segments per 90° of arc. Higher = rounder curve, no visible "steps".
    private static final int CORNER_SEGMENTS = 18;

    // Width (px) of the soft fade drawn around every shape's edge.
    // The game's HUD framebuffer isn't multisampled, so a hard triangle edge
    // shows as a jagged staircase - this fakes real AA by letting GL_BLEND
    // do the smoothing with a per-vertex alpha gradient instead.
    private static final float AA_FEATHER = 1.25f;

    private MorzhSmoothRenderer() {}

    // ---------------- Rounded rectangles ----------------

    public static void roundedRect(DrawContext context, float x, float y, float width, float height, float radius, int packedColor) {
        roundedRect(context, x, y, width, height, radius, packedColor, 0, 0f);
    }

    public static void roundedRect(DrawContext context, float x, float y, float width, float height, float radius, int fillColor, int outlineColor, float outlineThickness) {
        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;

        Renderer2D r = Renderer2D.COLOR;
        r.begin();

        Color fill = unpack(fillColor);

        if (outlineThickness > 0 && (outlineColor >>> 24) > 0) {
            Color outline = unpack(outlineColor);

            fill(r, x, y, width, height, radius, outline);
            fill(r, x + outlineThickness, y + outlineThickness,
                width - outlineThickness * 2, height - outlineThickness * 2,
                Math.max(0, radius - outlineThickness), fill);

            feather(r, x, y, width, height, radius, outline);
        }
        else {
            fill(r, x, y, width, height, radius, fill);
            feather(r, x, y, width, height, radius, fill);
        }

        r.render(context.getMatrices());
    }

    /**
     * Variant of roundedRect that assumes Renderer2D.COLOR.begin() was already called
     * by the caller and therefore does not call begin()/render(). Use when drawing
     * inside an existing Renderer2D batch (e.g. HudRenderer).
     */
    public static void roundedRectNoBegin(DrawContext context, float x, float y, float width, float height, float radius, int packedColor) {
        roundedRectNoBegin(context, x, y, width, height, radius, packedColor, 0, 0f);
    }

    public static void roundedRectNoBegin(DrawContext context, float x, float y, float width, float height, float radius, int fillColor, int outlineColor, float outlineThickness) {
        if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;

        Renderer2D r = Renderer2D.COLOR;

        Color fill = unpack(fillColor);

        if (outlineThickness > 0 && (outlineColor >>> 24) > 0) {
            Color outline = unpack(outlineColor);

            fill(r, x, y, width, height, radius, outline);
            fill(r, x + outlineThickness, y + outlineThickness,
                width - outlineThickness * 2, height - outlineThickness * 2,
                Math.max(0, radius - outlineThickness), fill);

            feather(r, x, y, width, height, radius, outline);
        }
        else {
            fill(r, x, y, width, height, radius, fill);
            feather(r, x, y, width, height, radius, fill);
        }
    }

    // ---------------- Circles ----------------

    public static void circle(DrawContext context, float cx, float cy, float radius, int packedColor) {
        if (radius <= 0) return;

        Renderer2D r = Renderer2D.COLOR;
        r.begin();

        Color color = unpack(packedColor);
        arc(r, cx, cy, radius, 0, 360, CORNER_SEGMENTS * 4, color);
        featherCorner(r, cx, cy, radius, 0, 360, color);

        r.render(context.getMatrices());
    }

    // ---------------- Text ----------------
    // Always routes through the client's own font system (Fonts.RENDERER),
    // never the blocky vanilla Minecraft font.

    public static void text(DrawContext context, String text, double x, double y, int packedColor, boolean shadow) {
        MorzhFontRenderer.draw(context, text, x, y, packedColor, shadow);
    }

    public static double textWidth(String text) {
        return MorzhFontRenderer.width(text);
    }

    // ---------------- Internals ----------------

    private static void fill(Renderer2D r, double x, double y, double w, double h, double radius, Color color) {
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

        radius = Math.max(0, Math.min(radius, Math.min(w, h) / 2.0));

        if (radius < 0.5) {
            r.quad(x, y, w, h, color);
            return;
        }

        r.quad(x + radius, y, w - radius * 2, h, color);
        r.quad(x, y + radius, radius, h - radius * 2, color);
        r.quad(x + w - radius, y + radius, radius, h - radius * 2, color);

        arc(r, x + radius, y + radius, radius, 180, 270, CORNER_SEGMENTS, color);
        arc(r, x + w - radius, y + radius, radius, 270, 360, CORNER_SEGMENTS, color);
        arc(r, x + w - radius, y + h - radius, radius, 0, 90, CORNER_SEGMENTS, color);
        arc(r, x + radius, y + h - radius, radius, 90, 180, CORNER_SEGMENTS, color);
    }

    private static void arc(Renderer2D r, double cx, double cy, double radius, double startDeg, double endDeg, int segments, Color color) {
        double startRad = Math.toRadians(startDeg);
        double stepRad = Math.toRadians(endDeg - startDeg) / segments;

        double prevX = cx + Math.cos(startRad) * radius;
        double prevY = cy + Math.sin(startRad) * radius;

        for (int i = 1; i <= segments; i++) {
            double angle = startRad + stepRad * i;
            double px = cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
            double py = cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius;

            r.triangle(cx, cy, prevX, prevY, px, py, color);

            prevX = px;
            prevY = py;
        }
    }

    private static void feather(Renderer2D r, double x, double y, double w, double h, double radius, Color base) {
        Color solid = base.copy();
        Color clear = base.copy();
        clear.a(0);

        // Straight edges
        r.quad(x + radius, y - AA_FEATHER, w - radius * 2, AA_FEATHER, clear, clear, solid, solid);
        r.quad(x + radius, y + h, w - radius * 2, AA_FEATHER, solid, solid, clear, clear);
        r.quad(x - AA_FEATHER, y + radius, AA_FEATHER, h - radius * 2, clear, solid, solid, clear);
        r.quad(x + w, y + radius, AA_FEATHER, h - radius * 2, solid, clear, clear, solid);

        // Corners
        featherCorner(r, x + radius, y + radius, radius, 180, 270, solid);
        featherCorner(r, x + w - radius, y + radius, radius, 270, 360, solid);
        featherCorner(r, x + w - radius, y + h - radius, radius, 0, 90, solid);
        featherCorner(r, x + radius, y + h - radius, radius, 90, 180, solid);
    }

    private static void featherCorner(Renderer2D r, double cx, double cy, double radius, double startDeg, double endDeg, Color solid) {
        Mesh mesh = r.triangles;

        Color clear = solid.copy();
        clear.a(0);

        double startRad = Math.toRadians(startDeg);
        double stepRad = Math.toRadians(endDeg - startDeg) / CORNER_SEGMENTS;

        double prevOutX = cx + Math.cos(startRad) * (radius + AA_FEATHER);
        double prevOutY = cy + Math.sin(startRad) * (radius + AA_FEATHER);
        double prevInX = cx + Math.cos(startRad) * radius;
        double prevInY = cy + Math.sin(startRad) * radius;

        for (int i = 1; i <= CORNER_SEGMENTS; i++) {
            double angle = startRad + stepRad * i;

            double outX = cx + Math.cos(angle) * (radius + AA_FEATHER);
            double outY = cy + Math.sin(angle) * (radius + AA_FEATHER);
            double inX = cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
            double inY = cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius;

            int i1 = mesh.vec2(prevInX, prevInY).color(solid).next();
            int i2 = mesh.vec2(prevOutX, prevOutY).color(clear).next();
            int i3 = mesh.vec2(outX, outY).color(clear).next();
            int i4 = mesh.vec2(inX, inY).color(solid).next();

            mesh.quad(i1, i2, i3, i4);

            prevOutX = outX; prevOutY = outY;
            prevInX = inX; prevInY = inY;
        }
    }

    private static Color unpack(int packedColor) {
        return new Color(packedColor >> 16 & 255, packedColor >> 8 & 255, packedColor & 255, packedColor >>> 24);
    }
}


===== meteor-fork\src\main\java\meteordevelopment\meteorclient\gui\morzh\MorzhThunderScreen.java =====
package meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.screens.morzh;

import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.settings.BoolSetting;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.settings.DoubleSetting;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.settings.EnumSetting;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.settings.IntSetting;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.settings.Setting;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.settings.SettingGroup;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.systems.config.Config;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.systems.modules.Category;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.systems.modules.Module;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.systems.modules.Modules;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.utils.sound.MorzhSoundManager;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.Screen;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

public class MorzhThunderScreen extends Screen {
    private static final int BACKGROUND = 0xB9000000;
    private static final int PANEL = 0xF0161616;
    private static final int PANEL_BORDER = 0xFF080808;
    private static final int HEADER = 0xFF5A2E77;
    private static final int HEADER_BOTTOM = 0xFF8E52B5;
    private static final int MODULE = 0xED1D1D1D;
    private static final int MODULE_HOVER = 0xFF29232D;
    private static final int SETTING_BACKGROUND = 0xF2111111;
    private static final int SEARCH_BACKGROUND = 0xF0161616;
    private static final int SEARCH_FOCUSED = 0xFF211A26;

    private static final int ACCENT = 0xFF9A5CE0;
    private static final int TEXT = 0xFFF3ECFA;
    private static final int TEXT_SECONDARY = 0xFFAFA6B5;
    private static final int ENABLED = 0xFF8D59B2;
    private static final int DISABLED = 0xFF1D1D1D;
    private static final int SLIDER_BACKGROUND = 0xFF28202D;

    private static final int PANEL_WIDTH = 116;
    private static final int HEADER_HEIGHT = 16;
    private static final int MODULE_HEIGHT = 15;
    private static final int SETTING_HEIGHT = 14;
    private static final int PANEL_GAP = 6;

    private static final int SEARCH_WIDTH = 180;
    private static final int SEARCH_HEIGHT = 18;

    private final Map<Category, CategoryPanel> panels = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<Module, Boolean> expandedModules = new HashMap<>();
    private final List<Hitbox> hitboxes = new ArrayList<>();

    private CategoryPanel draggingPanel;
    private int dragOffsetX;
    private int dragOffsetY;

    private Hitbox draggedSlider;

    private String search = "";
    private boolean searchFocused;

    private int searchX;
    private int searchY;

    private String tooltip;
    private boolean initialized;

    public MorzhThunderScreen() {
        super(Text.literal("Morzh Client"));
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        if (!initialized) {
            int x = 7;
            int y = 31;

            for (Category category : Modules.loopCategories()) {
                panels.put(
                    category,
                    new CategoryPanel(category, x, y)
                );

                x += PANEL_WIDTH + PANEL_GAP;
            }

            initialized = true;
        }

        searchX = Math.max(
            5,
            (width - SEARCH_WIDTH) / 2
        );

        searchY = 6;

        MorzhSoundManager.playOpen();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldPause() {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(
        DrawContext context,
        int mouseX,
        int mouseY,
        float delta
    ) {
        context.fill(
            0,
            0,
            width,
            height,
            BACKGROUND
        );

        hitboxes.clear();
        tooltip = null;

        renderSearch(context, mouseX, mouseY);

        for (Category category : Modules.loopCategories()) {
            CategoryPanel panel = panels.get(category);

            if (panel != null) {
                renderPanel(
                    context,
                    panel,
                    mouseX,
                    mouseY
                );
            }
        }

        if (tooltip != null && !tooltip.isBlank()) {
            context.drawTooltip(
                textRenderer,
                Text.literal(tooltip),
                mouseX,
                mouseY
            );
        }

        super.render(
            context,
            mouseX,
            mouseY,
            delta
        );
    }

    private void renderSearch(
        DrawContext context,
        int mouseX,
        int mouseY
    ) {
        searchX = Math.max(
            5,
            (width - SEARCH_WIDTH) / 2
        );

        boolean hovered = inside(
            mouseX,
            mouseY,
            searchX,
            searchY,
            SEARCH_WIDTH,
            SEARCH_HEIGHT
        );

        drawBorder(
            context,
            searchX,
            searchY,
            SEARCH_WIDTH,
            SEARCH_HEIGHT,
            searchFocused ? ACCENT : PANEL_BORDER
        );

        context.fill(
            searchX + 1,
            searchY + 1,
            searchX + SEARCH_WIDTH - 1,
            searchY + SEARCH_HEIGHT - 1,
            searchFocused || hovered
                ? SEARCH_FOCUSED
                : SEARCH_BACKGROUND
        );

        context.fill(
            searchX + 1,
            searchY + SEARCH_HEIGHT - 2,
            searchX + SEARCH_WIDTH - 1,
            searchY + SEARCH_HEIGHT - 1,
            searchFocused ? ACCENT : HEADER
        );

        String displayed;

        if (search.isEmpty()) {
            displayed = searchFocused
                ? "Type module name..."
                : "Search modules";
        } else {
            displayed = search;

            if (
                searchFocused
                    && (System.currentTimeMillis() / 450L) % 2L == 0
            ) {
                displayed += "_";
            }
        }

        drawText(
            context,
            shorten(displayed, 27),
            searchX + 6,
            searchY + 5,
            search.isEmpty()
                ? TEXT_SECONDARY
                : TEXT
        );
    }

    private void renderPanel(
        DrawContext context,
        CategoryPanel panel,
        int mouseX,
        int mouseY
    ) {
        List<Module> modules =
            getDisplayedModules(panel.category);

        int contentHeight = 0;

        if (!panel.collapsed) {
            for (Module module : modules) {
                contentHeight += MODULE_HEIGHT;

                if (expandedModules.getOrDefault(
                    module,
                    false
                )) {
                    contentHeight +=
                        countVisibleSettings(module)
                            * SETTING_HEIGHT;
                }
            }
        }

        int maximumContentHeight = Math.max(
            20,
            height - panel.y - HEADER_HEIGHT - 8
        );

        int visibleContentHeight = Math.min(
            contentHeight,
            maximumContentHeight
        );

        int panelHeight =
            HEADER_HEIGHT
                + visibleContentHeight;

        drawBorder(
            context,
            panel.x,
            panel.y,
            PANEL_WIDTH,
            panelHeight,
            PANEL_BORDER
        );

        context.fill(
            panel.x + 1,
            panel.y + 1,
            panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 1,
            panel.y + HEADER_HEIGHT,
            HEADER
        );

        context.fill(
            panel.x + 1,
            panel.y + HEADER_HEIGHT - 2,
            panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 1,
            panel.y + HEADER_HEIGHT,
            HEADER_BOTTOM
        );

        drawText(
            context,
            panel.category.name,
            panel.x + 4,
            panel.y + 4,
            TEXT
        );

        drawText(
            context,
            panel.collapsed ? "+" : "-",
            panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 10,
            panel.y + 4,
            TEXT
        );

        hitboxes.add(
            new Hitbox(
                HitboxType.PanelHeader,
                panel.x,
                panel.y,
                PANEL_WIDTH,
                HEADER_HEIGHT,
                panel,
                null,
                null
            )
        );

        if (panel.collapsed) {
            return;
        }

        context.fill(
            panel.x + 1,
            panel.y + HEADER_HEIGHT,
            panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 1,
            panel.y + panelHeight - 1,
            PANEL
        );

        int contentTop =
            panel.y + HEADER_HEIGHT;

        int contentBottom =
            contentTop + visibleContentHeight;

        float minimumScroll = Math.min(
            0,
            visibleContentHeight - contentHeight
        );

        panel.scroll = MathHelper.clamp(
            panel.scroll,
            minimumScroll,
            0
        );

        context.enableScissor(
            panel.x + 1,
            contentTop,
            panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 1,
            contentBottom
        );

        int rowY =
            contentTop + Math.round(panel.scroll);

        for (Module module : modules) {
            boolean hovered = inside(
                mouseX,
                mouseY,
                panel.x + 1,
                rowY,
                PANEL_WIDTH - 2,
                MODULE_HEIGHT
            );

            int moduleColor;

            if (module.isActive()) {
                moduleColor = hovered
                    ? 0xFF744895
                    : ENABLED;
            } else {
                moduleColor = hovered
                    ? MODULE_HOVER
                    : DISABLED;
            }

            context.fill(
                panel.x + 1,
                rowY,
                panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 1,
                rowY + MODULE_HEIGHT,
                moduleColor
            );

            context.fill(
                panel.x + 2,
                rowY + MODULE_HEIGHT - 1,
                panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 2,
                rowY + MODULE_HEIGHT,
                0xFF101010
            );

            drawText(
                context,
                shorten(module.title, 16),
                panel.x + 4,
                rowY + 4,
                module.isActive()
                    ? TEXT
                    : TEXT_SECONDARY
            );

            boolean expanded =
                expandedModules.getOrDefault(
                    module,
                    false
                );

            if (hasVisibleSettings(module)) {
                drawText(
                    context,
                    expanded ? "-" : "+",
                    panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 10,
                    rowY + 4,
                    TEXT_SECONDARY
                );
            }

            if (hovered) {
                tooltip = module.description;
            }

            if (
                rowY + MODULE_HEIGHT >= contentTop
                    && rowY <= contentBottom
            ) {
                hitboxes.add(
                    new Hitbox(
                        HitboxType.Module,
                        panel.x + 1,
                        rowY,
                        PANEL_WIDTH - 2,
                        MODULE_HEIGHT,
                        panel,
                        module,
                        null
                    )
                );
            }

            rowY += MODULE_HEIGHT;

            if (expanded) {
                for (SettingGroup group :
                    module.settings) {
                    for (Setting<?> setting : group) {
                        if (!setting.isVisible()) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        renderSetting(
                            context,
                            panel,
                            module,
                            setting,
                            rowY,
                            mouseX,
                            mouseY,
                            contentTop,
                            contentBottom
                        );

                        rowY += SETTING_HEIGHT;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        context.disableScissor();
    }

    private void renderSetting(
        DrawContext context,
        CategoryPanel panel,
        Module module,
        Setting<?> setting,
        int y,
        int mouseX,
        int mouseY,
        int contentTop,
        int contentBottom
    ) {
        boolean hovered = inside(
            mouseX,
            mouseY,
            panel.x + 1,
            y,
            PANEL_WIDTH - 2,
            SETTING_HEIGHT
        );

        context.fill(
            panel.x + 1,
            y,
            panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 1,
            y + SETTING_HEIGHT,
            hovered
                ? 0xFF201B23
                : SETTING_BACKGROUND
        );

        String name =
            shorten(setting.title, 11);

        drawText(
            context,
            name,
            panel.x + 5,
            y + 3,
            hovered ? TEXT : TEXT_SECONDARY
        );

        if (setting instanceof BoolSetting) {
            boolean value =
                (Boolean) setting.get();

            context.fill(
                panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 20,
                y + 3,
                panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 5,
                y + 11,
                value ? ACCENT : 0xFF343434
            );

            context.fill(
                value
                    ? panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 12
                    : panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 19,
                y + 4,
                value
                    ? panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 6
                    : panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 13,
                y + 10,
                TEXT
            );
        } else if (
            setting instanceof IntSetting
                || setting instanceof DoubleSetting
        ) {
            double progress =
                getSliderProgress(setting);

            int sliderX =
                panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH - 42;

            int sliderWidth = 36;

            context.fill(
                sliderX,
                y + 9,
                sliderX + sliderWidth,
                y + 11,
                SLIDER_BACKGROUND
            );

            context.fill(
                sliderX,
                y + 9,
                sliderX
                    + Math.round(
                    sliderWidth * (float) progress
                ),
                y + 11,
                ACCENT
            );

            String value =
                formatSettingValue(setting);

            drawText(
                context,
                value,
                panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH
                    - 5
                    - textRenderer.getWidth(value),
                y + 2,
                TEXT
            );
        } else {
            String value =
                shorten(
                    formatSettingValue(setting),
                    9
                );

            drawText(
                context,
                value,
                panel.x + PANEL_WIDTH
                    - 5
                    - textRenderer.getWidth(value),
                y + 3,
                TEXT
            );
        }

        if (hovered) {
            tooltip = setting.description;
        }

        if (
            y + SETTING_HEIGHT >= contentTop
                && y <= contentBottom
        ) {
            hitboxes.add(
                new Hitbox(
                    HitboxType.Setting,
                    panel.x + 1,
                    y,
                    PANEL_WIDTH - 2,
                    SETTING_HEIGHT,
                    panel,
                    module,
                    setting
                )
            );
        }
    }

    private List<Module> getDisplayedModules(
        Category category
    ) {
        List<Module> result =
            new ArrayList<>();

        String query =
            search.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        for (Module module :
            Modules.get().getGroup(category)) {
            if (
                Config.get()
                    .hiddenModules
                    .get()
                    .contains(module)
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            if (!query.isEmpty()) {
                boolean match =
                    contains(module.name, query)
                        || contains(module.title, query)
                        || contains(
                        module.description,
                        query
                    );

                if (!match) {
                    for (String alias :
                        module.aliases) {
                        if (contains(alias, query)) {
                            match = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (!match) {
                    continue;
                }
            }

            result.add(module);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private boolean contains(
        String value,
        String query
    ) {
        return value != null
            && value
            .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
            .contains(query);
    }

    private int countVisibleSettings(
        Module module
    ) {
        int count = 0;

        for (SettingGroup group :
            module.settings) {
            for (Setting<?> setting : group) {
                if (setting.isVisible()) {
                    count++;
                }
            }
        }

        return count;
    }

    private boolean hasVisibleSettings(
        Module module
    ) {
        return countVisibleSettings(module) > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(
        double mouseX,
        double mouseY,
        int button
    ) {
        int mx = (int) mouseX;
        int my = (int) mouseY;

        if (inside(
            mx,
            my,
            searchX,
            searchY,
            SEARCH_WIDTH,
            SEARCH_HEIGHT
        )) {
            searchFocused = true;

            if (
                button
                    == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT
            ) {
                search = "";
                resetPanelScroll();
            }

            MorzhSoundManager.playKeyPress();
            return true;
        }

        searchFocused = false;

        for (int i = hitboxes.size() - 1;
             i >= 0;
             i--) {
            Hitbox hitbox = hitboxes.get(i);

            if (!hitbox.contains(mx, my)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (
                hitbox.type
                    == HitboxType.PanelHeader
            ) {
                if (
                    button
                        == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT
                ) {
                    hitbox.panel.collapsed =
                        !hitbox.panel.collapsed;

                    MorzhSoundManager.playBoolean();
                } else if (
                    button
                        == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
                ) {
                    draggingPanel = hitbox.panel;
                    dragOffsetX =
                        mx - hitbox.panel.x;
                    dragOffsetY =
                        my - hitbox.panel.y;
                }

                return true;
            }

            if (
                hitbox.type
                    == HitboxType.Module
            ) {
                if (
                    button
                        == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
                ) {
                    hitbox.module.toggle();

                    MorzhSoundManager.playModuleState(
                        hitbox.module.isActive()
                    );
                } else if (
                    button
                        == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT
                ) {
                    boolean expanded =
                        expandedModules.getOrDefault(
                            hitbox.module,
                            false
                        );

                    expandedModules.put(
                        hitbox.module,
                        !expanded
                    );

                    MorzhSoundManager.playBoolean();
                }

                return true;
            }

            if (
                hitbox.type
                    == HitboxType.Setting
            ) {
                interactWithSetting(
                    hitbox,
                    mx,
                    button
                );

                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(
            mouseX,
            mouseY,
            button
        );
    }

    private void interactWithSetting(
        Hitbox hitbox,
        int mouseX,
        int button
    ) {
        Setting<?> setting =
            hitbox.setting;

        if (
            button
                == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE
        ) {
            setting.reset();
            MorzhSoundManager.playBoolean();
            return;
        }

        if (setting instanceof BoolSetting) {
            BoolSetting bool =
                (BoolSetting) setting;

            bool.set(!bool.get());
            MorzhSoundManager.playBoolean();
            return;
        }

        if (
            setting instanceof IntSetting
                || setting instanceof DoubleSetting
        ) {
            draggedSlider = hitbox;
            updateSlider(hitbox, mouseX);
            MorzhSoundManager.playScroll();
            return;
        }

        if (setting instanceof EnumSetting<?>) {
            cycleEnum(
                (EnumSetting<?>) setting,
                button
                    == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT
            );

            MorzhSoundManager.playBoolean();
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings({
        "rawtypes",
        "unchecked"
    })
    private void cycleEnum(
        EnumSetting<?> setting,
        boolean backwards
    ) {
        Enum current =
            (Enum) setting.get();

        if (current == null) {
            return;
        }

        Object[] values =
            current
                .getDeclaringClass()
                .getEnumConstants();

        int index = current.ordinal();

        index += backwards ? -1 : 1;

        if (index < 0) {
            index = values.length - 1;
        }

        if (index >= values.length) {
            index = 0;
        }

        ((Setting) setting).set(values[index]);
    }

    private void updateSlider(
        Hitbox hitbox,
        int mouseX
    ) {
        double progress =
            MathHelper.clamp(
                (
                    mouseX
                        - (
                        hitbox.x
                            + hitbox.width
                            - 44
                    )
                ) / 39.0,
                0,
                1
            );

        if (hitbox.setting
            instanceof IntSetting setting) {
            int minimum =
                setting.sliderMin;

            int maximum =
                setting.sliderMax;

            int value =
                (int) Math.round(
                    minimum
                        + (
                        maximum - minimum
                    ) * progress
                );

            setting.set(
                MathHelper.clamp(
                    value,
                    setting.min,
                    setting.max
                )
            );
        } else if (
            hitbox.setting
                instanceof DoubleSetting setting
        ) {
            double minimum =
                setting.sliderMin;

            double maximum =
                setting.sliderMax;

            double value =
                minimum
                    + (
                    maximum - minimum
                ) * progress;

            double multiplier =
                Math.pow(
                    10,
                    setting.decimalPlaces
                );

            value =
                Math.round(value * multiplier)
                    / multiplier;

            setting.set(
                MathHelper.clamp(
                    value,
                    setting.min,
                    setting.max
                )
            );
        }
    }

    private double getSliderProgress(
        Setting<?> setting
    ) {
        if (setting instanceof IntSetting value) {
            if (
                value.sliderMax
                    == value.sliderMin
            ) {
                return 0;
            }

            return MathHelper.clamp(
                (
                    value.get()
                        - value.sliderMin
                )
                    / (double) (
                    value.sliderMax
                        - value.sliderMin
                ),
                0,
                1
            );
        }

        if (
            setting
                instanceof DoubleSetting value
        ) {
            if (
                value.sliderMax
                    == value.sliderMin
            ) {
                return 0;
            }

            return MathHelper.clamp(
                (
                    value.get()
                        - value.sliderMin
                )
                    / (
                    value.sliderMax
                        - value.sliderMin
                ),
                0,
                1
            );
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private String formatSettingValue(
        Setting<?> setting
    ) {
        Object value = setting.get();

        if (value instanceof Double number) {
            String format =
                "%."
                    + Math.min(
                    3,
                    ((DoubleSetting) setting)
                        .decimalPlaces
                )
                    + "f";

            return String.format(
                Locale.ROOT,
                format,
                number
            );
        }

        return String.valueOf(value);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(
        double mouseX,
        double mouseY,
        int button,
        double deltaX,
        double deltaY
    ) {
        if (
            draggingPanel != null
                && button
                == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
        ) {
            draggingPanel.x =
                (int) mouseX - dragOffsetX;

            draggingPanel.y =
                (int) mouseY - dragOffsetY;

            draggingPanel.x =
                MathHelper.clamp(
                    draggingPanel.x,
                    -PANEL_WIDTH + 20,
                    width - 20
                );

            draggingPanel.y =
                MathHelper.clamp(
                    draggingPanel.y,
                    0,
                    Math.max(
                        0,
                        height - HEADER_HEIGHT
                    )
                );

            return true;
        }

        if (
            draggedSlider != null
                && button
                == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
        ) {
            updateSlider(
                draggedSlider,
                (int) mouseX
            );

            return true;
        }

        return super.mouseDragged(
            mouseX,
            mouseY,
            button,
            deltaX,
            deltaY
        );
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(
        double mouseX,
        double mouseY,
        int button
    ) {
        draggingPanel = null;
        draggedSlider = null;

        return super.mouseReleased(
            mouseX,
            mouseY,
            button
        );
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(
        double mouseX,
        double mouseY,
        double horizontalAmount,
        double verticalAmount
    ) {
        for (CategoryPanel panel :
            panels.values()) {
            if (inside(
                mouseX,
                mouseY,
                panel.x,
                panel.y,
                PANEL_WIDTH,
                height - panel.y
            )) {
                panel.scroll +=
                    (float) verticalAmount * 18;

                if (panel.scroll > 0) {
                    panel.scroll = 0;
                }

                MorzhSoundManager.playScroll();
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.mouseScrolled(
            mouseX,
            mouseY,
            horizontalAmount,
            verticalAmount
        );
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(
        int keyCode,
        int scanCode,
        int modifiers
    ) {
        if (searchFocused) {
            if (
                keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER
                    || keyCode
                    == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER
            ) {
                searchFocused = false;
                MorzhSoundManager.playKeyRelease();
                return true;
            }

            if (
                keyCode
                    == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE
            ) {
                if (!search.isEmpty()) {
                    search = search.substring(
                        0,
                        search.length() - 1
                    );

                    resetPanelScroll();
                }

                MorzhSoundManager.playKeyRelease();
                return true;
            }

            if (
                keyCode
                    == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_DELETE
            ) {
                search = "";
                resetPanelScroll();
                MorzhSoundManager.playKeyRelease();
                return true;
            }

            if (
                keyCode
                    == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE
            ) {
                searchFocused = false;
                MorzhSoundManager.playKeyRelease();
                return true;
            }
        }

        if (
            keyCode
                == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE
        ) {
            MorzhSoundManager.playClose();

            if (client != null) {
                client.setScreen(null);
            }

            return true;
        }

        return super.keyPressed(
            keyCode,
            scanCode,
            modifiers
        );
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(
        char chr,
        int modifiers
    ) {
        if (
            searchFocused
                && !Character.isISOControl(chr)
                && search.length() < 40
        ) {
            search += chr;
            resetPanelScroll();
            MorzhSoundManager.playKeyPress();
            return true;
        }

        return super.charTyped(
            chr,
            modifiers
        );
    }

    private void resetPanelScroll() {
        for (CategoryPanel panel :
            panels.values()) {
            panel.scroll = 0;
        }
    }

    private void drawText(
        DrawContext context,
        String value,
        int x,
        int y,
        int color
    ) {
        context.drawTextWithShadow(
            textRenderer,
            value,
            x,
            y,
            color
        );
    }

    private void drawBorder(
        DrawContext context,
        int x,
        int y,
        int width,
        int height,
        int color
    ) {
        context.fill(
            x,
            y,
            x + width,
            y + 1,
            color
        );

        context.fill(
            x,
            y + height - 1,
            x + width,
            y + height,
            color
        );

        context.fill(
            x,
            y,
            x + 1,
            y + height,
            color
        );

        context.fill(
            x + width - 1,
            y,
            x + width,
            y + height,
            color
        );
    }

    private boolean inside(
        double mouseX,
        double mouseY,
        int x,
        int y,
        int width,
        int height
    ) {
        return mouseX >= x
            && mouseX <= x + width
            && mouseY >= y
            && mouseY <= y + height;
    }

    private String shorten(
        String value,
        int maximumLength
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        if (value.length() <= maximumLength) {
            return value;
        }

        return value.substring(
            0,
            Math.max(0, maximumLength - 2)
        ) + "..";
    }

    private enum HitboxType {
        PanelHeader,
        Module,
        Setting
    }

    private static final class CategoryPanel {
        private final Category category;

        private int x;
        private int y;

        private float scroll;
        private boolean collapsed;

        private CategoryPanel(
            Category category,
            int x,
            int y
        ) {
            this.category = category;
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }

    private static final class Hitbox {
        private final HitboxType type;

        private final int x;
        private final int y;
        private final int width;
        private final int height;

        private final CategoryPanel panel;
        private final Module module;
        private final Setting<?> setting;

        private Hitbox(
            HitboxType type,
            int x,
            int y,
            int width,
            int height,
            CategoryPanel panel,
            Module module,
            Setting<?> setting
        ) {
            this.type = type;
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.width = width;
            this.height = height;
            this.panel = panel;
            this.module = module;
            this.setting = setting;
        }

        private boolean contains(
            int mouseX,
            int mouseY
        ) {
            return mouseX >= x
                && mouseX <= x + width
                && mouseY >= y
                && mouseY <= y + height;
        }
    }
}

package meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.renderer;

import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.utils.Cell;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.widgets.WWidget;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.gui.widgets.containers.WContainer;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.renderer.DrawMode;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.renderer.Mesh;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.renderer.ShaderMesh;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.renderer.Shaders;
import meteordevelopment.meteorclient.utils.render.color.Color;
import net.minecraft.client.util.math.MatrixStack;

public class GuiDebugRenderer {
    private static final Color CELL_COLOR = new Color(25, 225, 25);
    private static final Color WIDGET_COLOR = new Color(25, 25, 225);

    private final Mesh mesh = new ShaderMesh(Shaders.POS_COLOR, DrawMode.Lines, Mesh.Attrib.Vec2, Mesh.Attrib.Color);

    public void render(WWidget widget, MatrixStack matrices) {
        if (widget == null) return;

        mesh.begin();

        renderWidget(widget);

        mesh.end();
        mesh.render(matrices);
    }

    private void renderWidget(WWidget widget) {
        lineBox(widget.x, widget.y, widget.width, widget.height, WIDGET_COLOR);

        if (widget instanceof WContainer) {
            for (Cell<?> cell : ((WContainer) widget).cells) {
                lineBox(cell.x, cell.y, cell.width, cell.height, CELL_COLOR);
                renderWidget(cell.widget());
            }
        }
    }

    private void lineBox(double x, double y, double width, double height, Color color) {
        line(x, y, x + width, y, color);
        line(x + width, y, x + width, y + height, color);
        line(x, y, x, y + height, color);
        line(x, y + height, x + width, y + height, color);
    }

    private void line(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2, Color color) {
        mesh.line(
            mesh.vec2(x1, y1).color(color).next(),
            mesh.vec2(x2, y2).color(color).next()
        );
    }
}
